header_sentences: See Create at DLW 65. DLW 167. DLW 171. DLW 307. DLW 349. DP 3. DWis 12:end. Angelic Idea of Creation. CanonsNC 9.

contexts.text: When the Lord is called Creator, Former, or Maker, each term always involves a distinct idea in the internal sense. AC 10373:2.
The Creator of heaven and earth = the Regenerator. References. AC 10634:2. AE 328:10.
They say they acknowledge one Supreme Being, the Creator of the universe; but really acknowledge no God. AC 2747:2. AC 6197:end. AC 7097:4. AC 7251. SE 169. SE 857. SE 1449. SE 4772:2.
Hence the Lord is so often called Former, and Creator.
What would this be for the Infinite Creator?
In God the Creator, Who is the Lord from eternity, are these three (end, cause, and effect).
Jehovah the Creator is the Lord from eternity... Who cannot understand that there is one God the Creator of the universe, and not three Creators?
Jehovah the Lord from eternity the Creator; in time, the Saviour; and to eternity, the Reformer...
In the midst of that Sun is Jehovah God, the Creator and Upholder of the universe.
That the uses of all things in the universe reveal the Creator.
